summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running any code. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and widens ControlCode with Tuple[ControlType, str]; rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title classmethod, which passes a single two-item tuple to the constructor; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor/set_alt_screen, gated only on is_terminal, returning a bool, with the required docstring warnings; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch that calls term.set_title(title) once; CHANGELOG.md gets an Added heading above Fixed with a bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (returns early on legacy consoles), test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only via the existing skip marker). Not verified: pytest, mypy, and black were not run; new test lines were checked by hand against the 88-character limit. No commits were made.
